name: Copper bars
doc: Sine-bobbing raster bars with a metallic gradient over the input, one per frequency band (low bands in front are thickest on bass hits), coloured along the palette; optional rippled water reflection below a horizon.

palette.doc: bar colours, low band to high

bars.doc: bar count; the 16 bands are shared among them

center.doc: middle of the bobbing range, screen heights from the top

thickness.doc: half height of a silent bar

react.doc: how much a bar's band thickens and brightens it

spread.doc: bob phase step from bar to bar, radians

front.doc: 1 = bars cover the input, 0 = bright input shows through in front

horizon.doc: water line: below it the picture is mirrored and rippled (1 = none)
